t: Seeds of Change – Hope Grow Thrive
s: Grain for Change allows POET producers to directly impact the life of a farmer in Kenya by giving through a gift of grain. When a producer brings grain to one of the POET plants, they can designate a percentage of the load to go to Seeds of Change. Not only do they benefit from the opportunity to change a life, but giving in this way provides multiple tax savings!
